mockResponses.ai-implementation: I treat LLMs as collaborators in practical workflows. Every implementation starts with model selection—Codex for code, Claude for reasoning, Gemini for multimodal—then orchestration using LangChain or LlamaIndex. I focus on function calling, prompt chaining, and vector databases like LanceDB to create agentic systems that actually deliver value without the hype.
mockResponses.design-systems-leadership: Scaling teams and systems starts with trust. At Kinesso, I grew our design org from 2 to 30 by building the Splash design system—500 components with atomic architecture and governance that unified 20+ products. We embedded UX into engineering and sales, cutting QA time 40% while boosting reuse 79%. The key was research discipline and weekly remix sessions that kept everyone co-owning the evolution.
mockResponses.portfolio-awards: Design work has earned multiple global awards. Splash and DXA took Indigo 2023: 3× Gold, 2× Silver. DXA also won Red Dot 2021 and Indigo 2022: 2× Gold, 2× Silver, 1× Bronze. These recognize measurable impact—audit time weeks to hours, 68% YoY user growth—while validating the blend of research, systems thinking, and orchestration that defines my approach.
mockResponses.current-ventures: WeReady diagnoses startup readiness using evidence-based methodology across four pillars: code quality, business viability, investment readiness, and design/UX. ListingPal generates complete real estate marketing campaigns in 90 seconds using AgentSelect™ framework—MLS-ready descriptions, social content, and paid ads. Both are through One Block Away LLC, my lab for AI MVP development and beneficial applications.
